dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: Hey! Alfry here, from the Adventurers' Guild Intelligence Department.

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: Got any intel you can share with me?

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: The winds are too strong! You need to raise your voice!

choices.text: I'd like to change party members.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Under such weather, eh? Feels like living the life of a born adventurer.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: No problem! Alfry will assemble your colleagues immediately!

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Now is not the time for self-introductions. Come in and take refuge!

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: I'm fine! An adventurer like me has to know his ABCs to surviving in the windy outdoors!

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Don't get blown away by the winds!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to change party members.

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: No problem! I'll call for partners for you now!

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: What are Adventure Reports?

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: The Guild provides different recommended areas to explore based on your Adventure Rank.

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: Which rank's Adventure Report would you like to see?

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: Rank 1–5

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Windrise</color> is recommended for rookie adventurers.

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: Go out of the front gates of Mondstadt, pass the bridge, and the steppe you come to would be <color=#00E1FFFF>Windrise</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: Any other rank's Adventure Report you'd like to see?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to ask about something.

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: Ask away. Helping Guild members is also our duty.

choices.text: Tell me about the Adventurers' Guild.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Ad astra abyssosque!

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Roughly speaking, we are a hub for adventurous friends who resolve all kinds of troubles for the people or organizations.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: We need to put food on the table, of course. So there will be rewards for completing commissions.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Katheryne at reception takes care of visitors.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Since you're interested, please pay them a visit!

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Me? I'm just an average person.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Well... unless knowing everyone in Teyvat is something to talk about.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: It's not that incredible... The info came mostly from the resources of the Intelligence Department of Adventurers' Guild.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: I'm also a member of the Intelligence Department. Aside from contacting and guiding, gathering information is also part of my job.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: We've chatted for so long. I guess I can say we're friends now?

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Come on, tell me something about you!

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: The Intelligence Department does not take part in commissions most of the time. We help adventurers to complete commissions by providing them with information.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: In simple terms, our functions can be divided into "collection" and "organization."

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Our field staff, known as investigators, handle the collection of information. An example is Fischl — she is an exceptional investigator.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: Others, like me, remain at the back-end and organize the information we have collected, before providing it to adventurers.

response.speaker: Alfry
response.text: So, the success of the adventurers is directly linked to the work of the Intelligence Department.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: Oh, you don't need my help?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you ever met someone who looks like me?

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: I know about you. You're the outlander who's just arrived in Mondstadt, right? I've had my eye on you since your arrival.

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: So you mean to say that there is another person like you? Another traveler from a faraway land?

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: ...How strange. To think that there were people in Teyvat who I had no knowledge of...
